name: Bateshwar Hindu Temples
short_description: Cluster of nearly 200 sandstone Hindu temples dedicated to Shiva and Vishnu built between 8th and 10th centuries, painstakingly restored under ASI supervision.

name: Chausath Yogini Temple (Mitawali)
short_description: Circular 14th-century temple situated atop a 100-foot hill comprising 64 peripheral chambers dedicated to Yoginis with a central Shiva shrine.

name: Garhi Padhavali
short_description: 10th-century fortress complex noted for its surviving ornate Mukhamandapa covered in intricately carved friezes and mythological figures.

name: Koshak Mahal
short_description: Square 15th-century Malwa sultanate palace complex commissioned by Mahmud Khilji featuring arched balconies and four distinct quadrantal chambers.

name: Kakanmath Temple (Suhania)
short_description: Towering 11th-century Kachchhapaghata-dynasty Shiva temple constructed using dry masonry without mortar, renowned for its imposing vertical spire.
